{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer with a tailored fit, waist-length cut, deep charcoal grey (#2F3438), heavy woven fabric.
Silk-poplin button-down shirt, classic collar, crisp white (#FFFFFF), smooth fluid weave.
High-waisted ponte trousers with a straight leg, mid-thigh to ankle length, black (#000000), stretchy matte knit.
Leather loafers with a low block heel, pointed toe, espresso brown (#3B2F2F), smooth calfskin.
Slim gold chain necklace with a small pendant, 18-inch drop, polished brass finish.

This outfit works perfectly for an early morning banking job interview by balancing professional authority with approachable sophistication. The structured blazer signals readiness and competence while the soft silk shirt adds a touch of modern elegance appropriate for a financial institution. Dark neutrals like charcoal and black ensure you look polished under fluorescent office lighting without appearing overly severe. Finally, the leather loafers provide all-day comfort for walking through campus or waiting areas, proving that style does not require sacrificing practicality."}
